CORRECTION, supersedes the validation.updated line written minutes earlier this session: that one described Phase 2 reading the REMEMBERED op (s_selectedOpByModel) and called its status-bar text a tooltip. Both were wrong. Fabio tested it in his own app and it failed in two directions - dragging an image in auto-selects i2i PROGRAMMATICALLY and setSelectedOp is guarded against exactly that, so `Cue all` greyed while the strip showed i2i; and after removing the chip the stale memory left it ENABLED under t2i. Fixed: MpiGalleryBlock.js now passes `getCueContext: () => ({ operation: activeOperation, model: activeModel })` into the grid mount and the grid calls it at right-click time; activeOperation is assigned unconditionally by the operation-change handler (MpiGalleryBlock.js:1344) so it tracks programmatic picks. This DELETED the modelHelpers import the first cut added. Also: this app has NO tooltips and none was ever written - `info` reaches MpiButton as data-info, which is the status bar; wording corrected everywhere. Info strings reworded per Fabio: 'No operation selected' / 'Cue all does not support the current operation' / 'No selected card matches the current operation'. Re-verified by a probe mounted ONCE whose callback return was mutated between right-clicks while s_selectedOpByModel was poisoned to the opposite value (reads 1->2->3 proves a live read, not a mount-time cache; hasTitleAttr false pins the no-tooltip rule). lint + lint:components clean, npm test 944/944, gallery desktop specs 11/11. The first harness passed while the feature was broken because it mounted the grid STANDALONE and fed it the op - Phase 4's permanent spec must go through the BLOCK.
Phase 3 ticked: the dispatch loop. Phase 4 (desktop spec + docs/gallery.md) is the only phase left.

Phase 3 BUILT: `_cueAllDispatch` in MpiGalleryBlock.js reads getRunPayload() ONCE (so all N jobs share one recipe) and calls enqueueGeneration per eligible group with mediaItems replaced by that card's own item - built in the same shape _tryAddMedia produces and tagged with the op's single required slot's key. Refuses under state.loopArmed (_onLaneDrain would re-fire forever), reports queued+skipped via StatusBar.notify, passes NO getNextGeneration, and adds no second _exitSelectionMode (the grid already does it). The grid.on('cue-all') subscription sits OUTSIDE _wirePromptBox, which runs at two mount sites - registering inside it would stack a listener on a re-wire and cue every job TWICE. Two sweep findings: (1) the plan's video row is unreachable and that is correct - `extend` declares one required video slot but NO model declares `extend`, because Video Extend ships as a Flow, so Cue all is image-only in practice; (2) eligibility filters slots by model while enqueueGeneration's findMissingMediaSlot does NOT, so an op with a second required slot of another type would pass the menu and be refused on every job - swept all 67 accepted (model, op, mediaType) combinations, 0 refused, now pinned by a new test in tests/cue-all-eligibility.test.cjs that asserts the invariant rather than restating the guard. Proved non-vacuous: 67 assertions execute and all 67 fail under a wrong expectation, plus an accepted>0 guard. lint + lint:components clean, npm test 945/945, gallery+smoke desktop specs 12/12. Icon `layers` confirmed fine by Fabio. STILL OWED (sandbox cannot reach, card is user-ux): queue depth reads N with N placeholders running in order, and each output's .meta sidecar naming a DIFFERENT source image - needs a project, installed models and a real GPU. Phase 4 not started.

CLARIFICATION on the sweep note: image-to-video IS batchable and the earlier 'image-only' phrasing was misleading. The batch AXIS is an image selection; the OUTPUT can be video. Verified per model: i2v on wan22-5b and i2v_ms on wan-22, ltx-23, ltx-23-balanced and minimax-h3 all return eligible=2 for a two-image selection, each image becoming that clip's startFrame (5 photos -> 5 clips, one of the card's two headline wins). Their endFrame and inputAudio slots are OPTIONAL and correctly not batch axes. What is genuinely unreachable is selecting VIDEO cards: that is `extend`, and no model declares it because Video Extend ships as a Flow. plan.md and validation.md corrected. FOLLOW-UP RAISED BY FABIO, now in progress: the batch slot must be the role the user EXPRESSED in the prompt box (MPI-466's role pill toggles a lone i2v_ms image between startFrame and endFrame), not the op's required slot - so 'try N different end frames' works.

FABIO FOLLOW-UP SHIPPED: the batch slot is the one the user EXPRESSED in the prompt box, not the op's required slot. On i2v_ms, MPI-466's role pill toggles a lone staged image between startFrame and endFrame, so 'try N different END frames' is a real request - the previous cut hardcoded the required slot and would have silently run all N as START frames, a wrong result that looks like a working one. Extracted as buildCueAllJobItems(operation, model, staged, card) in js/data/commandRegistry.js: it takes the role of the LAST staged chip of the batched media type (roles arrive pre-assigned by the PromptBox's _withAssignedRoles, so an untagged image still reads startFrame and the default is unchanged), falls back to the required slot when nothing is staged, and SUBSTITUTES the card IN PLACE rather than appending - because control, krea2Edit, kleinEdit and qwenEdit declare ORDINAL slots whose roles stripOrdinalMediaRoles drops so chip ORDER decides (MPI-330), and appending would shuffle a two-chip edit's base image into the slot being swept. Every other staged chip rides along untouched, which is what makes 'hold this start frame, sweep the end frame' work, and a staged audio chip is preserved too. Four new tests (14 in the file, 949 in the suite): the pill-tagged endFrame sweep, the surviving start frame + audio chip, the ordinal base-image order, and the empty/junk fallbacks. Both new assertions are discriminating by construction - i2v_ms's required slot IS startFrame, so a regression yields startFrame != endFrame, and appending yields a 3-element array against an expected 2. lint + lint:components clean, npm test 949/949, gallery+smoke desktop specs 12/12. Verified across 7 real-registry scenarios before extraction. STILL OWED (needs a project, models and a GPU): queue depth reads N, and each output's .meta sidecar naming a DIFFERENT source image in the swept slot.
